takeaways: Pimco CIO Dan Ivascyn says the 10-year Treasury could reach 6%, a level not seen since 2000; it closed at 5.24% on Oct 12, so CRE borrowers should plan for tighter underwriting and tougher refinancings.

REITs are shrugging off 5% Treasuries: senior-housing, hotel and data-center REITs lead with double-digit returns, and 58 of 98 REITs that issued guidance raised it, though new-debt coupons rose to 5.4%.
Private credit is under the microscope: the Mark Walter probe and $2.4B of Guggenheim outflows hit lenders, while Blackstone lines up a $3.5B CMBS refi of its AIR Communities portfolio.

items.headline: Pimco's Ivascyn: 10-year Treasury could hit 6%, first time since 2000
items.summary: Pimco CIO Dan Ivascyn says the 10-year could reach 6% as inflation, fuel costs, debt and forced hedge-fund selling push yields up; it closed at 5.242% on Oct 12. CRE should expect tighter underwriting, tougher refinancings and stalled deals, though Bianco Research has turned bullish on bonds. (via The Promote)

items.headline: REITs shrug off 5% Treasury; senior-housing REITs lead double-digit returns
items.summary: The FTSE Nareit All REIT index is up 6%+ year to date, and senior-housing, hotel and data-center REITs lead with double-digit returns. REITs raised $19.8B in Q3, new-debt coupons rose to 5.4% from 4.7% in Q1, and 58 of 98 guiding REITs raised outlooks.

items.headline: Blackstone lines up $3.5B CMBS refi of AIR Communities portfolio
items.summary: Blackstone is in talks with a Goldman Sachs-led syndicate on a $3.5B CMBS loan against about 30 AIR Communities properties, which would return about $320M. It bought the 76-property, 27K-unit portfolio in 2024 for $10B all-cash. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Mark Walter probe and $2.4B outflows shake Guggenheim private-credit machine
items.summary: Prosecutors and the SEC are examining whether Mark Walter's insurers properly disclosed loans to his other businesses; Delaware Life restated related-party holdings from about $1.4B to $17B+. No charges filed. Guggenheim funds saw $2.4B of September outflows, and its real estate platform has originated $18B+ since 2010. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Manhattan office vacancy falls to 12.6%, lowest since before 2020
items.summary: Q3 vacancy dropped from 13.1% in Q2 and 14.7% a year ago, with asking rent at $84.56/sf and some mid-tier space moving from about $75 to near $125/sf per JLL. About 7.9M sf under construction for 2028-2032 is largely preleased.

items.headline: Eldridge, Cain and Boehly build insurer-backed CRE lending machine
items.summary: Todd Boehly's Eldridge (about $75B AUM, anchored by Security Benefit) absorbed Cain's credit team and recently did a $278M Atlanta office refi, a $250M office-to-resi conversion loan and $155M for a West Chelsea condo. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Sunrise plans 50 luxury projects; Distinctive Living starts adaptive reuse
items.summary: Sunrise Senior Living plans about 50 new luxury communities as part of its $7.5B pipeline, while Distinctive Living set a New Jersey groundbreaking for an adaptive reuse effort, a path to adding senior units with limited new-build supply.

items.headline: From Turing Trap to Talent Trap: AI strategy risks stranding workers
items.summary: Opportunity@Work's Byron Auguste and Justin Heck say about 10M U.S. workers move up each year and half of gateway-to-higher-pay opportunities are highly AI-exposed (18.6M workers in the most exposed gateway jobs). They urge using AI to augment rather than replace workers, citing Walmart's steady-headcount pledge.

items.headline: LinkedIn pilots free 14-week 'Academy of Economic Opportunity'
items.summary: LinkedIn's pilot trains 30 employees three times weekly through simulations like PR crises and hiring decisions, with no prerequisite. Founder profiles rose nearly 23% in a year and AI-literacy job postings rose 70%, while U.S. employers added only 29,000 jobs last month.

items.headline: Aquarian's $4.1B Brighthouse buyout stalls amid Walter-fallout scrutiny
items.summary: Aquarian (about $25B AUM) co-led the $900M+ acquisition loan on Extell's UWS site; Extell is now in talks for $3.8B of JPMorgan-led construction financing. Its Brighthouse deal is dragging, though Aquarian says it has no relationship with Walter's companies. (via The Promote)

items.headline: Houston leads nation in accidental landlords as listings pile up
items.summary: Owners who cannot sell are renting instead, adding to Houston's rental supply as for-sale inventory hits records.

items.headline: Alphabet's Ruth Porat voices pragmatic optimism on the AI race
items.summary: Alphabet's Ruth Porat is optimistic about AI's benefits while warning of its possible downsides, at the MPW summit.

items.headline: KPMG eyes 200K sf Chicago move; Legacy and GI plan $300M+ data-center retrofit
items.summary: The Promote's Quickies note KPMG is eyeing 200K sf in Irvine Cos.' River North tower, and Legacy and GI are taking on a $300M+ retrofit of a trading hub into a data center. (via The Promote)

items.headline: McConaughey spent a weekend reading 20 years of bad reviews
items.summary: Despite a $200M career, Matthew McConaughey says he spent a weekend in the desert reading two decades of negative reviews and that some had merit, a lesson in seeking candid feedback.

items.headline: Sleep under 7 hours linked to lower life expectancy, second only to smoking
items.summary: An OHSU study in Sleep Advances found insufficient sleep (<7 hours) was still associated with shorter life expectancy after adjusting for inactivity, employment and education; only smoking was a stronger link. The study is observational.
